reviews.title: Subscription?!
reviews.text: I had this app for over 10 years. Today i restored it and now I have to buy a subscription. This should be illegal.

reviews.title: Full screen pop ups to sell me stuff
reviews.text: Pester. A verb: to harass with petty irritations : ANNOY

reviews.title: zero stars if I could
reviews.text: Unfortunately, Merriam-Webster, you have lost the battle to the internet. Ain’t no WAY I am either paying for no ads or having to wait while ads load just to look up a definition that the internet could give me in 0.2 seconds. Give up. It’s not your fault, just the way of the times. Merriam-Webster has been defeated by far superior forces.

reviews.title: Ads ruin the experience
reviews.text: I thought using this app would be an easier way to look up words than using the Merriam-Webster site on my browser app. With these full screen unskippable and jarring ads showing up every few times I look up a word it's unusable. The exit button once it shows up is difficult to spot. There's no way to report an offensive or eye-straining ad that I've seen. Horrid app, just use the website.

reviews.title: Far too many ads
reviews.text: Was a good dictionary app until they filled it to the brim with ads. My final straw was when I looked up a word only to find out that that particular word was put behind a subscription paywall and unless I wanted to pay actual money I was out of luck. Needless to say, I have since deleted this app without there being any chance I come back.

reviews.title: ads
reviews.text: ads on a dictionary app are ridiculous when i can google a word ad free. deleting for this reason

reviews.title: Add the games
reviews.text: Please add the word games!! I played reunion, tagline, and the loop everyday but I obviously can’t save it just on my browser. Please put the REAL WORD GAMES on the app 😭😭🙏🙏

reviews.title: Unusable due to ads
reviews.text: This app is a complete waste of time with its constant and unrelenting advertisements. I had to delete it just to stay sane. You can hardly look up two words without being bombarded with full-screen ads that can’t be closed unless you follow the link or completely close out the app and reopen it to start again. It’s just not worth the hassle.

reviews.title: Pay, or run…
reviews.text: The ads in the free version are intolerable and frequent. Big yikes. As bad as the ads are, why would I agree to pay just to not be annoyed? It’s some weird kind of bullying. And charging for an app when you can just use a browser?… or pay for Oxford instead?… It’s a crime. Experiment complete, app deleted.

reviews.title: Utter Garbage
reviews.text: A significant downgrade from just using the website. Bloated with ads and has the audacity to require a subscription for things already on the website for free. Shameful.

reviews.title: Meh
reviews.text: A minimal dictionary at best. I am so sorry I gave up my hard copy versions. But if nothing else, explain to me why a computer based dictionary is incapable of finding words based upon ambiguous spelling, or using, at the very least, a simplified version of regular expressions, which is old, old technology, and there is no excuse for not doing so. Like I said: MEH!

reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text: This app does not be at all. It’s actually garbage and all you do is sit there watch ads and then blows up on you and you can’t even use it.
